summary: +1 to attack and damage rolls; it can salt water.
text: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. As a Magic action you can touch it to up to a gallon of liquid and make it as salty as seawater.

powers.name: Salt Water

params.text: turns up to a gallon of touched water as briny as the sea

powers.text: Magic action: up to a gallon of liquid you touch with it turns salty. (No other effect in the game.)
